data.description: Your shape changes to that of a dire bat (Bestiary p30). While in this form, you gain a fly speed of 40 feet (clumsy) and blindsense with a range of 10 feet.|PREVARLT:ShifterBatAspectLVL,8

Your shape changes to that of a dire bat (Bestiary p30). While in this form, you gain a fly speed of 80 feet (good), blindsense with a range of 20 feet, you gain a bite attack (1d8 damage), you gain the Flyby Attack feat (Bestiary p315), and you gain the Hover feat (Bestiary p315).|PREVARGTEQ:ShifterAspectLVL,15
